paragraphs: Ireland and the UK are getting on better now. Ireland's Foreign Affairs Minister, Helen McEntee, said this on Sunday.
On Friday, the UK and the European Union made a big new deal. UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham agreed it in Brussels. It is the biggest change in trade since the Brexit vote in 2016.
From March 2028, most food, animal and plant products will not need checks. This will also help trade between Britain and Northern Ireland.
Up to 100,000 young people can live in another country for up to three years. They can work, study or travel there.
Taoiseach Micheál Martin called the deal a big win for Irish and British businesses. McEntee said it is the start of a reset. She hopes the two sides will work together more.
sentZh: 愛爾蘭和英國現在相處得更好了。
愛爾蘭外交部長海倫・麥肯蒂在週日這麼說。
週五，英國和歐盟達成了一項重大的新協議。
英國首相安迪・伯納姆在布魯塞爾同意了這項協議。
這是自2016年脫歐公投以來貿易方面最大的改變。
從2028年3月起，大多數食品、動物和植物產品將不需要檢查。
這也將有助於英國本島和北愛爾蘭之間的貿易。
最多十萬名年輕人可以到另一個國家生活最長三年。
他們可以在那裡工作、讀書或旅行。
總理米歇爾・馬丁稱這項協議是愛爾蘭和英國企業的一大勝利。
麥肯蒂說這是重新開始的起點。
她希望雙方能更多地合作。

paragraphs: Ireland's Minister for Foreign Affairs, Helen McEntee, says relations between Ireland and the UK are now in a better place. She spoke after the UK and the European Union agreed an important new deal on Friday.

UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham made the deal with EU leaders at a meeting in Brussels. It is the biggest change in trade between the two sides since the Brexit vote in 2016. Some people think it could also bring the UK closer to the EU in the future.

Under the deal, most animal and plant products will not need certificates or checks from March 2028. This also covers goods that travel between Britain and Northern Ireland. Northern Ireland will keep its access to the EU single market.

There will also be a youth scheme. Up to 100,000 young people will be able to spend up to three years in Britain or the EU. They can work, study, volunteer or travel. The two sides also plan to talk about migration, student fees and defence.
UK officials will be able to give advice on some EU laws, such as rules on food, but they will not be able to vote on them.

McEntee said there has been a huge change in the way the UK deals with the EU. She called the deal the start of a reset and hopes it will lead to more co-operation. Taoiseach Micheál Martin said the end of food checks is a big win for businesses in both countries. Burnham said the deal is good for Britain and good for Europe.
sentZh: 愛爾蘭外交部長海倫・麥肯蒂表示，愛爾蘭與英國的關係現在處於更好的狀態。
她是在英國和歐盟於週五達成一項重要新協議後發表這番話的。
英國首相安迪・伯納姆在布魯塞爾的一場會議上與歐盟領袖達成這項協議。
這是自2016年脫歐公投以來雙方貿易最大的改變。
有些人認為，這也可能讓英國未來更靠近歐盟。
根據協議，從2028年3月起，大多數動物和植物產品將不需要證書或檢查。
這也涵蓋在英國本島與北愛爾蘭之間運送的貨物。
北愛爾蘭將保留進入歐盟單一市場的管道。
另外還會有一項青年計畫。
最多十萬名年輕人將能在英國或歐盟待上最長三年。
他們可以工作、讀書、當志工或旅行。
雙方也計畫討論移民、學費和國防問題。
英國官員將能對部分歐盟法律提供意見，例如食品規定，但他們不能對這些法律投票。
麥肯蒂說，英國與歐盟往來的方式已有巨大改變。
她稱這項協議是重新開始的起點，並希望它能帶來更多合作。
總理米歇爾・馬丁說，取消食品檢查對兩國企業都是一大勝利。
伯納姆說這項協議對英國有利，對歐洲也有利。

paragraphs: Relations between Ireland and the UK have improved following a landmark agreement between London and Brussels, according to Minister for Foreign Affairs Helen McEntee.

The deal was agreed on Friday by UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham and EU leaders at a summit in Brussels. It is widely seen as the most significant development in trading relations since the 2016 Brexit referendum, and it may mark the beginning of a political thaw.

Its central measure removes the need for certificates and checks on most animal and plant products traded between the EU and the UK from March 2028. The change will also apply to goods moving between Britain and Northern Ireland, while Northern Ireland retains access to the EU single market. The two sides will also reconnect their emissions trading systems.

In addition, a youth experience scheme will allow up to 100,000 young people to spend as long as three years working, studying or travelling in Britain or the EU. The agreement also includes a structured dialogue on migration, a six-month deadline to settle university fees and a commitment to closer defence ties.
UK officials will be consulted on EU rules in areas such as food standards, which Britain will have to follow, but they will have no vote.

In a statement, McEntee described a massive shift in the UK's approach to Europe and said she hoped the reset would bring greater co-operation. Taoiseach Micheál Martin called the removal of agri-food checks a major win for Irish and British firms and suggested that fewer trade barriers would benefit Ireland. Burnham, citing Treasury analysis, said the deal could raise UK economic output by 0.5 per cent.
sentZh: 外交部長海倫・麥肯蒂表示，在倫敦與布魯塞爾達成一項里程碑式協議後，愛爾蘭與英國的關係已有所改善。
這項協議由英國首相安迪・伯納姆與歐盟領袖於週五在布魯塞爾的高峰會上達成。
它被普遍視為自2016年脫歐公投以來貿易關係最重要的進展，也可能標誌著政治關係開始解凍。
其核心措施是自2028年3月起，取消歐盟與英國之間大多數動植物產品貿易所需的證書與檢查。
這項改變也將適用於在英國本島與北愛爾蘭之間流通的貨物，而北愛爾蘭仍保有進入歐盟單一市場的管道。
雙方也將重新連結各自的碳排放交易制度。
此外，一項青年體驗計畫將允許最多十萬名年輕人在英國或歐盟工作、讀書或旅行，時間最長可達三年。
協議還包括一項關於移民的結構化對話、在六個月內解決大學學費問題的期限，以及加強國防關係的承諾。
在食品標準等英國必須遵守的領域，英國官員將就歐盟規則接受諮詢，但他們沒有投票權。
麥肯蒂在一份聲明中形容英國對歐洲的態度出現了巨大轉變，並表示希望這次重啟能帶來更多合作。
總理米歇爾・馬丁稱取消農產食品檢查是愛爾蘭與英國企業的一大勝利，並暗示貿易壁壘減少將使愛爾蘭受惠。
伯納姆引用財政部的分析指出，這項協議可使英國經濟產出提高0.5%。

paragraphs: Anglo-Irish relations have entered a markedly warmer phase in the wake of a landmark accord between London and Brussels, Minister for Foreign Affairs Helen McEntee has said.

The agreement, struck on Friday by UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham and EU leaders at a summit in Brussels, is regarded as the most consequential shift in trading arrangements since the 2016 Brexit referendum. Some observers believe it could herald a broader political thaw, gradually drawing Britain back towards the European fold.

At its heart is the abolition, from March 2028, of certificates and inspections for most agri-food products crossing between the two jurisdictions. Crucially, the exemption extends to goods moving between Britain and Northern Ireland, which will nonetheless retain its access to the EU single market. Emissions trading schemes are also to be relinked.

The package further provides for a youth mobility scheme enabling up to 100,000 young people to live, work or study abroad for up to three years, alongside a structured dialogue on migration, a six-month window to resolve the thorny issue of tuition fees and a pledge to bolster defence co-operation.

Under the arrangement, British officials will be entitled to offer counsel on EU legislation governing areas such as food standards, to which the UK will be bound, though they will be denied voting rights.

McEntee hailed a sea change in Britain's posture towards the bloc, describing the deal as the opening of a reset that she hoped would foster deeper collaboration. Taoiseach Micheál Martin characterised the scrapping of agri-food checks as a significant victory for businesses on both islands and even floated the prospect of the UK rejoining the customs union. Burnham, for his part, invoked Treasury projections of a 0.5 per cent uplift in national output, while cautioning that incremental steps could only achieve so much.
sentZh: 外交部長海倫・麥肯蒂表示，在倫敦與布魯塞爾達成一項里程碑式協定之後，英愛關係已進入明顯回暖的階段。
這項協定由英國首相安迪・伯納姆與歐盟領袖於週五在布魯塞爾高峰會上敲定，被視為自2016年脫歐公投以來貿易安排最具影響力的轉變。
一些觀察人士認為，這可能預示更廣泛的政治解凍，逐步將英國拉回歐洲的懷抱。
協定的核心是自2028年3月起，取消往來兩個司法管轄區之間大多數農產食品的證書與檢驗。
關鍵在於，這項豁免也延伸至在英國本島與北愛爾蘭之間流通的貨物，而北愛爾蘭仍將保有進入歐盟單一市場的管道。
雙方的碳排放交易機制也將重新連結。
這套方案還包括一項青年流動計畫，讓最多十萬名年輕人能出國生活、工作或讀書長達三年，同時設立移民問題的結構化對話、用六個月時間解決棘手的學費問題，並承諾加強國防合作。
根據這項安排，英國官員將有權就規範食品標準等領域的歐盟法規提供意見，英國須受這些法規約束，但官員們將不享有投票權。
麥肯蒂盛讚英國對歐盟的姿態出現了根本性轉變，並形容這項協議是重啟的開端，希望能促成更深入的合作。
總理米歇爾・馬丁形容取消農產食品檢查是兩島企業的重大勝利，甚至提出英國重新加入關稅同盟的可能性。
伯納姆則援引財政部預測，指國家產出可提升0.5%，同時提醒循序漸進的步驟能達成的成果有限。

paragraphs: According to Minister for Foreign Affairs Helen McEntee, relations between Ireland and the United Kingdom have improved substantially as a consequence of a landmark agreement between the UK and the European Union.

The accord, concluded on Friday by UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham and EU leaders in Brussels, is widely considered the most significant development in bilateral trade since the 2016 referendum. Furthermore, it may signal a gradual political rapprochement between the two parties.

The principal provision eliminates certification and inspection requirements for the majority of agri-food products traded between the EU and the UK from March 2028. Significantly, this exemption also applies to goods transported between Britain and Northern Ireland, which will nevertheless maintain its access to the EU single market. In addition, the respective emissions trading systems are to be reconnected.

The agreement also establishes a youth mobility scheme permitting up to 100,000 young people to reside abroad for a maximum of three years. Other elements include a structured dialogue on migration, a six-month deadline for an arrangement on tuition fees, which is contingent upon equal treatment of European students, and a commitment to enhanced defence co-operation.
British officials will be consulted on EU legislation in domains such as food standards, with which the UK must comply; however, they will not possess voting rights.

McEntee characterised the development as a fundamental transformation in the UK's approach and expressed the hope that it would facilitate greater co-operation. Similarly, Taoiseach Micheál Martin argued that the removal of agri-food checks would be highly advantageous for Irish and British enterprises. Burnham, referring to Treasury analysis, estimated that the deal could increase UK gross domestic product by approximately 0.5 per cent, while acknowledging that incremental measures have inherent limitations.
sentZh: 根據外交部長海倫・麥肯蒂的說法，由於英國與歐盟達成一項里程碑式協議，愛爾蘭與英國的關係已大幅改善。
這項由英國首相安迪・伯納姆與歐盟領袖於週五在布魯塞爾簽定的協定，被普遍認為是自2016年公投以來雙邊貿易最重要的進展。
此外，這可能預示雙方在政治上將逐步修好。
主要條款是自2028年3月起，取消歐盟與英國之間大多數農產食品貿易的認證與檢驗要求。
值得注意的是，這項豁免也適用於在英國本島與北愛爾蘭之間運輸的貨物，而北愛爾蘭仍將維持進入歐盟單一市場的管道。
此外，雙方各自的碳排放交易制度也將重新連結。
協議還設立一項青年流動計畫，允許最多十萬名年輕人在海外居住最長三年。
其他內容包括移民問題的結構化對話、在六個月內就學費達成安排的期限（前提是歐洲學生須獲得平等待遇），以及加強國防合作的承諾。
在食品標準等英國必須遵守的領域，英國官員將就歐盟立法接受諮詢；然而，他們將不具投票權。
麥肯蒂形容這一進展是英國態度的根本轉變，並表示希望它能促進更多合作。
同樣地，總理米歇爾・馬丁認為，取消農產食品檢查將對愛爾蘭與英國企業極為有利。
伯納姆引用財政部的分析，估計這項協議可使英國國內生產毛額增加約0.5%，同時也承認漸進式措施本身有其侷限。
